entities.summary: Kōtarō Kiyomiya  is a Japanese professional baseball first baseman for the Hokkaido Nippon-Ham Fighters of Nippon Professional Baseball (NPB). A left-handed batter and right-handed thrower, Kotaro stands 6 feet 0 inches (1.83 m) tall and weighs 225 pounds (102 kg). He was the first pick of the Fighters in the 2017 draft. He is the son of Japanese rugby union coach, Katsuyuki Kiyomiya.
